sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 233334 (per-site catalog)

values.note: $26 a night in peak season, covering two vehicles (or RV/trailer and tow vehicle); $9 each additional vehicle, which interagency passes don't discount. Off season no fee and no amenities.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cabin-creek-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night', 'Off Season, there is no fee and no amenities available', '$9.00 each additional vehicle', 'Interagency Passes not applicable toward additional vehicle fees') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233334/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233334 (all 15 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, water hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Trailer/RV Sites Average parking spur: 22' X 30''; recreation.gov lists 28-29 ft on the four sites that give a length.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cabin-creek-campground ('Camp sites: 15', 'Trailer/RV Sites Average parking spur: 22' X 30'') + recreation.gov catalog for 233334 (15 sites; Max Vehicle Length 28-29 where given), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No dump station at any ExplorUS-managed Custer Gallatin campground. Firewood $10 a bundle at the host site; trash pickup. The FS page's amenity block also says 'Restrooms are not available at this site', against its own and recreation.gov's 'Vault toilets ... are provided'.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233334 ('Vault toilets and drinking water are provided'; notices 'There are NO Shower facilities available at this campground', 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest', 'Firewood is available for sale at host site for $10.00/bundle') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cabin-creek-campground ('Potable water is available at this site', 'Trash Pickup: Yes'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: All 15 sites reservable on recreation.gov (also a self-pay station). 16 consecutive nights.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cabin-creek-campground ('View this site on Recreation.gov', 'Make Reservations Here') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233334 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16; amenity 'Self Pay Station') + catalog (15 of 15 reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Custer Gallatin NF campground between Hebgen and Earthquake Lakes, 8 mi north of West Yellowstone on US-191 then 14 mi west on US-287; across the road from the Madison River, in mature pine and Douglas fir. Concession-run by ExplorUS. Cabin Creek Trail starts at the campground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $26 (2026; +$9 extra vehicle), 15 sites, 30-ft average spur, drinking water, vault toilets, no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov (platform was inherited), 16-night limit. Added season May 15 - Sept 20, no showers, no dump station, concessionaire ExplorUS. Not stated: booking window (180 inherited left), fcfs. Note trimmed of restated values.
